title: Completed exchange coherence
statement:
Completed exchange of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map] is
natural in $K$, equals the identity for identity squares, and satisfies
horizontal and vertical pasting after the canonical associativity
isomorphisms.

note:
*Source note:* no Stacks Project entry states these coherence properties of
the completed exchange: Theorem 61.30.1 ([Tag
09C9](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C9)) asserts only that the
base-change map is an isomorphism, Lemma 61.20.2 ([Tag
099N](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/099N)) gives the functoriality of
$Lf^*_{comp}$ and of $Rf_*$ alone, and the nearest recorded coherence of the
two ingredients is the commutativity of the projection formula with the base
change map, Remark 21.50.2 ([Tag
0E48](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0E48)), stated for a single
square of ringed topoi without coefficients or completion. The blueprint
adds naturality in $K$, the identity-square statement and horizontal and
vertical pasting for the completed exchange.

proof.text: Write $F_u=Lu^*_{\mathrm{comp}}$ and $R_u=Ru_*$, retaining the ordered formula $\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp}}=c^{-1}\operatorname{Rlim}(v'_\bullet)s$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map]. Restriction of scalars is an equivalence on the full complete categories by [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-ordered-exchange-coefficient-comparison] supplies the actual comparisons $\chi_u:\operatorname{Res}R_u\simeq R_u^0\operatorname{Res}$ and $\phi_u:\operatorname{Res}F_u\simeq F_u^0\operatorname{Res}$, identifying the completed adjunctions with their units and counits. Here $F_u^0=C_Uu^*$ and $C_U$ is the reflector of [lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction]. That lemma says $R_u^0$ preserves completeness, so completed pullbacks and intermediate direct images remain complete. The equivalence reflects the equations to be proved. The ambient constant and completed module categories remain distinct.

source.place: Second paragraph: reconstruction and completion coordinates (Stacks 099M, 099N).

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization] with the proper square and the retained witnesses of the definition. With $\bar K_\bullet=\operatorname{Res}K_\bullet$ it gives actual natural isomorphisms $b:\operatorname{Res}B_\bullet\simeq G_gR_f^{\mathcal T}\bar K_\bullet$ and $d:\operatorname{Res}D_\bullet\simeq R_{f'}^{\mathcal T}G_{g'}\bar K_\bullet$ and the equation $d\operatorname{Res}(v'_\bullet)=E^{\mathcal T}_{\bar K_\bullet}b$ in the derived category of strict towers. Here $E^{\mathcal T}$ is the constant-$A$ ringed mate, not the bounded-below abelian etale exchange. Apply the actual functor $\operatorname{Rlim}$ of [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality] to this equation. It preserves composition and inverses, giving the same conjugation equation between the derived limits. This starts from equality of tower morphisms; no inference from levelwise equalities is made.

source.place: First paragraph and start of second: coherent finite exchange lifted to a strict tower mate before taking R lim.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ordered-exchange-coefficient-comparison] (2)--(3). Its strict comparison $\rho_K$ identifies $\operatorname{Res}K_\bullet$ with $\mathcal R_X\bar K$. With $\lambda$ denoting restriction/limit comparison, it states
$$\mathcal L(\beta)\lambda_B\operatorname{Res}(s)=s^0\iota_S,\quad\mathcal L(\delta)\lambda_D\operatorname{Res}(c)=t^0\iota_T,\quad\delta\operatorname{Res}(v')=E^{\mathcal T}\beta.$$
The maps $\beta,\delta$ are precisely Step 2's $b,d$ followed by $\rho_K$. These equations include the diagram projection-formula comparison and both reconstruction identifications; no extra normalization is inferred from the description of $b,d$. Functoriality and cancellation give
$$\iota_T\operatorname{Res}(c^{-1}\operatorname{Rlim}(v')s)=(t^0)^{-1}\mathcal L(E^{\mathcal T})s^0\iota_S.$$
Use [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]: its hypotheses hold since $A$ is Noetherian and every $P_n$ is perfect. For its exact $s^0,t^0$, the right side is $E^c\iota_S$. Thus the specified ordered exchange is the completed adjunction mate. The new comparison gives the same equations for the raw ordered construction on every complete input, without witnesses.

source.place: Second paragraph: conjugation by the specified reconstruction, projection-formula and direct-image/limit maps; missing comparison supplied by the existing general tool.

proof.text: Fix the completed composition maps precisely as in [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]: they are conjugate under the completed adjunctions to the canonical derived direct-image composition maps of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. These are the canonical associativity maps in the claim, not finite-level composition maps. To check their coherence, constant-coefficient inverse images are exact, so their right adjoints preserve K-injective complexes by [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective]. On a K-injective $J$, each successive direct image is therefore already K-injective. All iterated direct-image composition comparisons are the section restriction identifications for the same composite map. Their associativity and unit equations hold on sections, and hence on these complexes and in the derived category. The conjugate bijection [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], which preserves composition and identities and reverses their order, gives the corresponding coherence of completed pullbacks. Thus the pullback square for an outer rectangle is the corresponding paste of the two completed pullback squares.

source.place: Second paragraph: the canonical associativity and identity maps in the completed equations.

proof.text:
For horizontal squares $\square_1=(f,f',g,g')$ and $\square_2=(f',f'',h,h')$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] (1) to their completed pullback squares. Step 4 identifies the pasted square with the outer pullback square. With canonical composition maps suppressed, its conclusion is
$$E^c_{21}=(E^c_2F_{g'})\circ(F_hE^c_1).$$
For vertical squares $\square_1$ and $\square_3=(e,e',g',g'')$, clause (2), then clause (3) for the canonical composition conjugates, gives
$$E^c_{13}=(R_{f'}E^c_3)\circ(E^c_1R_e).$$
Insert the comparison maps of Step 4 on the sources and targets to obtain exactly horizontal and vertical pasting after canonical associativity isomorphisms. Outer rectangles are cartesian by [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting] (also applied after transposing the diagram). Step 3 identifies these mates with the completed exchanges of the item wherever that definition is applied.

source.place: Second paragraph: horizontal and vertical S8 equations, using mates on the complete categories.

proof.text: The intermediate inputs are $F_{g'}K$ for horizontal pasting and $R_eK$ for vertical pasting; they are complete by Step 1. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ordered-exchange-coefficient-comparison] to each of these very objects. Its raw map $x^a$ uses the same ordered $s,c$ and the specified strict diagram projection-formula realization of exchange; its equality with $(t^0)^{-1}\mathcal L(E^{\mathcal T})s^0$ requires no etale-origin witnesses. By [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison] these raw arrows are therefore the $E^c$ arrows in Step 5, including at $R_eK$. At any witnessed input the new comparison identifies the raw map with the map of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map]. Substituting these equalities into Step 5 proves the pasting laws for the specified completed exchanges and their raw intermediate components. For identity squares use Step 4's identity comparisons. Clause (4) of [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] gives identity when the horizontal edges are identities; with identity vertical adjunctions, the unit--square--counit formula of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] is itself the identity. Thus both identity orientations hold.

source.place: Second paragraph: intermediate completed inputs and S0 identity equations; general complete-input extension avoids extra witness hypotheses.

proof.text:
The mate of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] is a natural transformation. For any $k:K\to H$ of complete objects its equation is
$$R_{f'}^0F_{g'}^0(\operatorname{Res}k)E^c_{\bar K}=E^c_{\bar H}F_g^0R_f^0(\operatorname{Res}k).$$
The comparisons and equalities of [lem-weil-pbc-ordered-exchange-coefficient-comparison] are natural for all such $k$. Step 3 therefore substitutes the ordered exchanges into this equation, with $\iota_S,\iota_T$ intertwining the two functor images of $k$. Naturality of those isomorphisms and cancellation prove the naturality equation for the original coefficient categories. Neither lifts of $k$ nor compatible choices of finite witnesses are required. The equivalence of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence] reflects this equation and the identity and pasting equations proved in Steps 5--6.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
The completed exchange map is natural in $K$, is the identity for identity
squares, and commutes with horizontal and vertical pasting.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
At every finite level these equations are the S0/S8 equations. They commute
with the tower transitions by naturality of coefficient reduction. Apply
$R\varprojlim$ to each equality and conjugate by the same reconstruction,
projection-formula, and direct-image/limit isomorphisms used in the definition.
The resulting equations are precisely the completed equations.

split_report.summary: Repair of the returned seven-step split: retain strict-tower mate normalization and the identity/pasting arguments; add one statement-only coefficient comparison giving Res/Ru_* and completed-adjunction compatibility, an actual strict reduction-tower isomorphism, the projection-formula and both reconstruction identifications, and the exact s,c normalization on every complete input without witnesses. Steps 3 and 6 now cite this result explicitly. No item statement change.
split_report.blueprint: Current blueprint paragraphs 1--2, retaining the 2026-10-14 normalization and ordered reconstruction/limit route. The new coefficient lemma isolates the missing comparison inside the former long conjugation step; the item proves coherence using mate-pasting.

tool_uses.why: Generic Noetherian completion reflector and completed pullback adjunction on arbitrary small sites; supplies completeness of intermediate inputs and fixed adjunction normalization. The unit has no equally general completed adjunction statement.

Generic comparison of the specified strict-tower projection/limit construction with the completed adjunction mate, with no geometric or witness hypotheses. It fills precisely the conjugation gap in the existing blueprint route; no same-unit statement supplies this comparison.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-N8-eea7a7ef5 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, the new node and every cited statement in full, plus the main-20261015 and master blueprint texts, unit sk-thm-properbasechange, and Stacks 0B54/0944/0A07/099N. Steps 1-7 hold. Base-change morphism: the definition's c^{-1}Rlim(v')s, with v'=H'R(e)H^{-1} fixed by the reviewed normalization lemma, so it does not depend on the witness. Coefficient categories: completed A_T and constant underline-A are kept distinct and compared only through Res (an equivalence on complete objects) and the comparisons chi, phi, rho, beta, delta, lambda. I recomputed the Step 3 cancellation: iota_T Res(x)=(t^0)^{-1}L(E^T)s^0 iota_S, and this equals E^c iota_S by mate-comparison (A Noetherian, P_n perfect). The mate-pasting clauses (1)-(4) match the horizontal and vertical formulas; Step 4 coherence follows from K-injective preservation, kappa normalization and the conjugate bijection; identity squares and naturality are correct. New node lem-weil-pbc-ordered-exchange-coefficient-comparison: true clause by clause. Res has an exact flat left adjoint, so it preserves K-injectives and commutes with u_*. H^a and H'^a are invertible for any morphism because (P_n)_T is perfect over A_T, so dropping properness is valid. Small cases checked: K=0, A=0, I=A, I=0 with A finite, A=Z with I=(l). It is not a restatement of the item (no identity or pasting law) and not a duplicate: lem-weil-pbc-flat-ringed-diagram-restriction gives only the termwise ingredients, and the O_E and finite-ring analogues are narrower. No cycle. Accepted tool_uses: lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction and lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison, both generic constant-coefficient facts with no geometric hypotheses. The departure from blueprint paragraph 1 avoids its invalid levelwise-to-tower inference and keeps the paragraph 2 conjugation.
